events.title: No Elevator Demo Releases Sept 17! - Can you beat the skyscraper?
events.summary: Hey everyone!This still feels unreal to say, but our Free No Elevator demo is coming out on September 17.We've spent months making this Rage-ish game about claustrophobic guy and his toxic relationship with building, and in a couple of days you'll finally be able to play it yourself. The demo takes around 30–40 minutes, but it's completely upto your skillset. There's 45 Floors in the Demo Build and in the full game it will be much much more!
